summary: Full backend + frontend testing of RefSync OS. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases passed covering match CRUD, event creation for goal/card/substitution, event ordering by (minute, added_minute), finish flow, and validation errors (invalid type/team/card_color, missing match). Frontend: end-to-end flow validated on 390x844 mobile viewport - timer starts at 00:00, INICIAR advances clock (00:02 after 2.5s), PAUSA freezes main and starts +Tiempo Añadido, REANUDAR resumes, GOAL modal (numpad + team toggle + confirm) works and score updates, CARD flow (dorsal -> next -> yellow) saves event, SUBSTITUTION (SALE/ENTRA + numpad) saves event, RESUMEN shows all 3 recorded events with correct icons/colors/teams, FIN DE PARTIDO calls finishMatch + creates new match resetting scoreboard (0-0) and timer (00:00) to stopped state, and the new summary shows summary-empty. No red screens, no deprecated packages (uses expo-haptics, expo-image, expo-router only). All testIDs from the spec are present and working.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend correctly excludes MongoDB _id via projection {'_id': 0} on every read - good.
server.py uses @app.on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI in favor of lifespan handlers. Not blocking, still functions.

MAIN_CAP in match.tsx caps main timer at 45:00 as required; currentMinute uses Math.floor(mainMs/60000)+1 so events during a paused/stopped state still record minute=1 which matches spec (minute captured at confirm time).
api.ts hardcodes JSON Content-Type and passes {} body on createMatch - works with MatchCreate defaults.
Frontend does not surface addEvent mutation errors to the user (no toast/alert on failure). Consider adding user feedback on network errors - non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: None - tests create their own match/event data per fixture and rely on random UUIDs (no cleanup needed since data is scoped per match).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests reusable at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Run with: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/ -v. Frontend flows validated end-to-end via Playwright at 390x844. All testIDs listed in the review request are present and functional: play-pause-button, action-goal/card/substitution, main-timer, added-timer, numpad-key-<n>, team-toggle-home/away (in TeamToggle component), goal-confirm-button, card-next-button, card-yellow-button, card-red-button, sub-field-out, sub-field-in, sub-confirm-button, open-summary-button, end-match-button, event-row-<id>, summary-empty.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. MVP works as designed.
